notes.title: FIRST MAJOR UPDATE
notes.notes:
Dear Elves, 

We are happy to announce part of the changes we have implemented in A Very Bad Christmas Eve coming with today's update. 

(1)  Graphics overhaul and optimisation  

(2)  Manual  - we added an additional Game Manual in the Main Menu

(3)  Different Game Difficulties  - you can challenge yourself in “Terrible Elf”, “Bad Elf” and “Master Elf” Game Modes

(4)  Interactables  - almost everything is interactable

(5) Other small changes and (6) Bug fixes


 What is coming next? 

(1)  Up to three new Critical Machines  

(2)  Themed Rooms for every Critical Machine  

(3)  Leaderboards  

(4)  Achievements  

(5)  More Interactables  


Elves, let us know what do you think. Do you want us to implement some other features? 


We will be extremely happy and grateful to have you as a part of our inspiring community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480650/A_Very_Bad_Christmas_Eve/

We are social.

Best wishes and thank you for being part of our community,
Incineration Production’s Team
